published_ranges._notes: Official Prusament PLA/PLA (Blend) TDS v1.1 (16-02-2022), read from prusament.com as PDF (the >10 MB zip was not needed). Nozzle printed as '210 +/- 10' (single value, kept in published_ranges, not fields); density 1.24 ISO 1183; diameter '1.75 +/- 0.02 mm (+/- 0.03 mm for PLA Blend)'; HDT 0.45 MPa 55C and 1.80 MPa 55C (ISO 75); MFR, moisture absorption 0.13%/24h. No Vicat or drying in TDS; drying 45C 6 hours from Prusa Knowledge Base drying table ('PLA/rPLA'). prusament.com material page: temperature resistance 55C. No max volumetric speed published. Bambu Studio Prusament preset not confirmed; parent is Bambu's PLA Basic. Earlier entry: Product page prints nozzle '210 +/- 10' (fields = 200-220), bed 40-60, fan 100%, temperature resistance 55 C (metric not stated). Print surfaces listed: PEI, glass plate, painter's tape, glue stick. Official TDS is only published inside a >10 MB zip that could not be read, so density/diameter/HDT/tolerance were left out.
published_ranges._nozzle_temperature: 210 +/- 10 (single printed value with tolerance; not put in fields per rules)

conflicts: Reseller-hosted Polish TDS copy (kamami.pl, v1.0 27.07.2022, filed as PLA Blend) gives HDT 1.80 MPa 52.5C and diameter +/-0.03 - older version; v1.1 official value 55 kept
